Enabled.Name: Roll damage automatically on a hit
Enabled.Hint: After an attack roll, roll that attack's damage if it hit at least one targeted token. Misses roll nothing.

AutoApply.Name: Apply damage automatically
AutoApply.Hint: Apply the rolled damage to every target that was hit, respecting resistances, immunities and vulnerabilities. Turn off to apply it yourself from the damage card (for example to halve it).

NoTarget.Name: Roll damage when nothing is targeted
NoTarget.Hint: With no targeted tokens a hit can't be judged. On: roll the damage anyway so you can apply it by hand. Off: roll nothing.

Hold.Name: Hold my rolls for review
Hold.Hint: Every roll you make for others to see (attacks, damage, saves, checks, initiative, table draws) is shown to you only, with Reroll, Confirm and Discard; you can also change the result. Players see nothing, not even a private roll, until you confirm. Attacks get one card for the attack and its damage. Rolls you make private yourself pass through as usual. Off: your rolls go straight through.

Crits.Name: Roll on the critical hit and failure tables
Crits.Hint: On a critical hit or critical failure of an attack roll, draw from the house tables in the folder Critical Hits and Failures: Tables 1 and 2 for player characters' weapon attacks, 3 and 4 for their spell attacks, 5 and 6 for everyone else. Your own draws are held for review like your other rolls.

Notify.NoPermission: Auto Damage: you can't change {name}'s hit points, so the damage was rolled but not applied.
